features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries with metadata
features.evidence: Single-doc indexing now updates index-meta.json and marks doc indexed with chunk count; removeDocument() added. Smoke test: design-notes.md -> 6 chunks (211-464 chars), status ready.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, file type, and paragraph count metadata from documents
features.evidence: extractMetadata() in document-service; shown in DocumentDetail. Smoke test on design-notes.md: 282 words, 43 lines, 15 paragraphs, md. npm run check passes.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with indexed count, total chunks, and color-coded status indicator
features.evidence: StatusBar shows color-coded status, Docs, Indexed n/N, Chunks, last activity, plus 'Index all' button. IndexStatus (with totalChunks) moved to shared/types.ts, replacing mismatched AppStatus. DELETE handler now calls indexingService.removeDocument(). Smoke test (2 docs): idle 0/2 0 chunks -> indexing 1/2 15 -> ready 2/2 23 -> after delete ready 1/1 8. npm run check passes.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations, excerpts, and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService returns top-2 keyword-matched chunk citations (title, chunkIndex, 200-char excerpt), confidence 0.85 with citations / 0.30 without, history persisted to qa-history.json. App.tsx answer panel now shows a confidence badge: green 'Well-grounded' vs amber italic 'Speculative'. Smoke test: 'How does the chunking pipeline work?' on ARCHITECTURE.md -> 0.85, 2 citations; nonsense query -> 0.30, 0 citations; history length 2 from a fresh QaService. npm run check passes.
